messages:
Nadia Kaur: Heads up - filed PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/821 to correct the "available_memory" field for Orion-XL model card (was listing DDR instead of HBMe). Needs quick review; it's tripping the embed limits table.

Owen Blake: Saw the CI failure - linkcheck complaining about /docs/limits.md anchor. I can patch that.

Nadia Kaur: Thanks. Also updating the embeddings limit note: "embedding vector size 1536, recommended batch <=64 for dedi-small"

runtime-ci: CI: docs-lint passed; linkcheck failure on anchor fixed by Owen.

Owen Blake: Pushed anchor fix. Also added a short note to the card that says "Memory field describes model resident memory; actual host memory reported by the runtime may be higher due to cache and prefetch buffers."

Nadia Kaur: Perfect. I'll merge after CI green and a final skim from @Owen.

docs-bot: PR 821 assigned to @Owen Blake.
